title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1968-08-21

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 8/21/68 concert with a smoking Dark Star > St. Stephen > The Eleven sequence captured on a solid soundboard source, though slightly flatter than other versions.
ai_review.review: This recording captures one of the standout nights of August ’68 – a fire‑filled second set highlighted by Dark Star > St. Stephen > The Eleven > Death Don’t Have Mercy and an inspired Alligator jam. The soundboard feed is generally clear, but listeners note a marginal loss of high‑frequency sparkle and an odd two‑track split that some find distracting.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently praised with multiple standout moments; recording is solid soundboard with only minor tonal flatness and editing quirks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall mix, organ well‑mic'd; slightly flatter high end compared to other versions and a questionable two‑track split that cuts off the end of Lovelight.

standout_songs: Dark Star > St. Stephen > The Eleven > Death Don't Have Mercy
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set is the highlight, essentially a Live Dead‑style sequence that flows tightly from Dark Star through St. Stephen and The Eleven into Death Don’t Have Mercy, then lifts into Lovelight and closes with strong jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: On fire on Lovelight; superb guitar‑bass interplay with Phil during Dark Star; delivers Goodnight theme and strong vocals throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Psychic bass‑guitar dance with Jerry in Dark Star; tight, driving low end supporting the jams.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ work is praised as stellar and well mic'd; noted that Tom Constanten had not yet joined the band.
